دَفَارِ (indecl., with kesr for its termination, TA) The female slave. (T, M, K.) Mostly used in vocative expressions. (TA.) One says to a female slave, (T, S, A, Msb,) reviling her, (S, Msb,) دَفَارِ, يَا meaning O thou stinking one! (T, S, A, Mgh, Msb:) alluding to her intrinsic foulness. (Msb.) ―
-b2- See also دَفْرٌ, last sentence.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
